title: NASA telepathy experiments and remote viewing the moon
summary: Greg tells of NASA telepathy experiments and remote viewing the moon, about 1960s at NASA, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So he he claims that they sent remote viewers to the moon

plain: A researcher called Greg says that in the 1960s a man named Andrija Puharich held contracts with NASA, the US space agency, for telepathy experiments, pointing to newspaper articles about them. According to Greg, Puharich claimed that NASA sent remote viewers, people said to see faraway places with the mind alone, to look at the moon. If true, the space agency was testing psychic methods alongside its rockets.
